the-hawaiian-archipelago: Intrepid traveler Isabella Bird — who rode alone through the Rockies — spent months in Hawaii in the 1870s, and these letters are her sparkling report. Volcanoes, missionaries, and the doomed Hawaiian kingdom come alive in her vivid prose. One of the great travel books of the nineteenth century.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-angola-and-co: A 1913 entry on Angola and Congo — the African missions. Thomas Shahan tells their long story. Portuguese priests came with the caravels. The old Kongo kingdom turned Christian. The Church's African frontier. Its martyrs watered the mission soil. Its missions revived in modern days.
